heating_cooling: Cold winters are the main threat. Plan to heat one small room; insulate windows; layer wool or synthetics; never use grills, ovens or generators indoors.

risks: Clear mountain streams can carry Giardia; treat all surface water.
Pipes and supplies freeze; keep water from freezing.
Many communities are off the road system; resupply may take weeks.
